Subject: Important Update Regarding Your Google Workspace Integration

Dear Dr. Patel,

I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to reach out about your integration — the calendar and contacts sync is now fully functional, and I'm sorry it took longer than anticipated. I also apologize for any confusion.

We'll continue to keep your integration reliable and secure — a testament to our commitment to excellence.

Google now requires a verification review for apps that access Gmail and Calendar data, which carries a $540/year fee. It must be completed by Oct 30 or your staff will see an unverified app warning. Please let us know how you'd like to proceed.

Warm regards,
Nate Seluga
